attestations.text: KÊNG Chi-mao 耿繼茂, d. 1671, was the eldest son of Kêng Chung-ming [q. v.] and a member of the Chinese Plain Yellow Banner. Like his father who fought vigorously against the Mings after he joined the Manchus, he was throughout his life a bitter opponent of the defunct dynasty.
